body:
Source: GitHub issue #681 (release-audit class false-green, P1-high). Re-verified on main @ 6ddd5992: `packages/merge-forecast/lib/forecast.mjs`'s concurrent-conflict gate (around line 140-151) filters `pairResults` on `pr.hardVeto` only — `hardVeto` is true ONLY for the 1.0 scope-overlap signal. A namespace-collision (0.8) or import-radius (0.6) pair sitting in the same topological wave produces NO gate failure and exit 0. `README.md`'s exit-code table (line ~29) says verbatim: `2: Gate fails — --width exceeds certifiedWidth, or vetoed/high-risk pair scheduled concurrently` — the "high-risk pair scheduled concurrently" half of that documented contract is unimplemented. Reproduced against the shipped bin: two tickets scoped to colliding namespace paths score `0.8, namespace-collision, SEQUENCE`, both land in wave 1, `gateFailures: []`, exit 0 — the tool's own `certifiedWidth: 1` correctly flags the risk, but nothing reads it unless the operator explicitly passes `--width`, and the README's own first documented example is the bare `merge-forecast` invocation with no `--width`.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package `packages/merge-forecast`: lib/forecast.mjs (`forecast(...)` — the function to fix; `conflictThreshold` is ALREADY a parameter with default `0.5`, already threaded into `pairResults` scoring via `pairScore(...)` which returns `{score, signal, hardVeto}` per pair — read the whole function, the `pairResults` construction happens just above the gate you're fixing), lib/{active-tickets,output,reachability,signals}.mjs, bin/merge-forecast.mjs (CLI wiring — check whether `conflictThreshold` is exposed as a flag already; if so, reuse it, do not add a duplicate). Tests: `npm test -w packages/merge-forecast`.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. Extend the concurrent-conflict `gateFailures` check: in addition to (or replacing — read the existing `concurrentVetoes` filter and decide whether to keep hard-veto pairs as their own distinct, more severely-worded failure message, or fold them into one combined check) the hard-veto-only filter, ALSO flag any pair with `pr.score >= conflictThreshold` scheduled in the same wave (same `waveMap` lookup logic already present). A hard-vetoed pair trivially satisfies `score >= conflictThreshold` in practice (1.0 >= 0.5), so a single unified filter (`pr.score >= conflictThreshold` and same wave) is likely sufficient and simpler than two separate checks — but preserve DISTINCT, clear message wording for a hard-veto pair vs. a merely-high-risk one if the existing message text already distinguishes them; read it before deciding.
2. The failure message must name the pair(s), their score, and their signal (e.g. `namespace-collision`) so an operator understands WHY the pair is flagged — mirror the existing `hardVeto` message's level of detail, extended to include `score`/`signal`.
3. `conflictThreshold` itself is UNCHANGED (default 0.5) — this ticket wires the ALREADY-COMPUTED threshold into the gate, it does not change what counts as high-risk.
4. This changes GATE FAILURE conditions (a behavior change to the CI-facing exit code), so update `README.md`'s documentation to match the NOW-correctly-implemented contract if any wording needs adjusting (it likely already says the right thing per the issue — if so, no README change needed; verify rather than assume).

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 The issue's own repro: two tickets scoped to colliding namespace paths (`namespace-collision`, score 0.8) both landing in wave 1 with no `--width` passed → `gateFailures` is non-empty, exit 2 (regression-fixing the exact reported case). verify: `node --test packages/merge-forecast/test/high-risk-concurrent.test.mjs`
- AC2 A pair below `conflictThreshold` (e.g. score 0.3) in the same wave does NOT gate-fail (no false positive from being overly aggressive). verify: `node --test packages/merge-forecast/test/high-risk-concurrent.test.mjs`
- AC3 A high-risk pair (score >= conflictThreshold) in DIFFERENT waves (sequenced, not concurrent) does NOT gate-fail — only CONCURRENT scheduling of a risky pair is the failure condition, matching the existing hardVeto check's own same-wave logic. verify: `node --test packages/merge-forecast/test/high-risk-concurrent.test.mjs`
- AC4 Regression: the existing hard-veto (score 1.0, scope-overlap) concurrent case still fails exactly as before (message content may be enriched per item 2, but the failure itself and its exit code are unchanged). verify: `npm test -w packages/merge-forecast` and `node --test packages/merge-forecast/test/high-risk-concurrent.test.mjs`
- AC5 A custom `--conflict-threshold`/whatever the CLI flag is actually named (if one exists — verify first) correctly changes which pairs trigger the new check. verify: `node --test packages/merge-forecast/test/high-risk-concurrent.test.mjs`
- AC6 Existing suite green (confirm actual baseline count; if any existing test in `test/forecast.test.mjs` asserted a 0.8-scored concurrent pair as a CLEAN/exit-0 result, rewrite it to the new correct behaviour and say so in the PR body — that would have been pinning the bug). verify: `npm test -w packages/merge-forecast`
- AC7 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 (also run `--max 80` once locally before review)

OUT OF SCOPE: changing `conflictThreshold`'s default value; the `--width`/`certifiedWidth` check (already correctly implemented, unrelated to this fix).

PROCESS (ADLC). Work only in your assigned worktree. P3: the rails on this ticket are frozen — if the fix appears to require editing a rail path, STOP and report; never set ADLC_RAILS_BYPASS. P4: TDD — write test/high-risk-concurrent.test.mjs first, run it RED, then implement. P5 before opening the PR: the package suite, `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` (exit 0), then the cross-model review loop (see lane instructions) until a round is clean. Do not add gate-manifest entries. Keep the diff to packages/merge-forecast/lib/forecast.mjs, possibly README.md, the new test, and this ticket's shard. PR title `fix(merge-forecast): ...`, body must contain `Closes #681`.
title: merge-forecast: gate on any high-risk pair (score >= conflictThreshold) scheduled concurrently, not only hard-vetoed pairs
